news.headline: Barclays Reaffirms Overweight Rating for Abivax, Price Target $148
news.summary: Barclays reiterated its Overweight rating on Abivax with a $148 price target in a note issued the day after the company's H1 2026 results, keeping the sell-side broadly constructive despite the wider-than-expected quarterly loss.

news.headline: Sell-Side Analysts Trim Price Targets on Abivax After Wider-Than-Expected H1 Loss
news.summary: In the session following Abivax's Sept 21 H1 2026 report, which showed a wider-than-expected per-share loss, Wedbush's David Nierengarten cut his price target to $118 from $140 while keeping a Neutral rating, and Truist's Gregory Renza trimmed his target to $151 from $155 while maintaining a Buy. Shares gave back ground even as most sell-side analysts continued to view obefazimod's regulatory and commercial trajectory positively.

news.headline: Abivax Presents Business Updates and First Half 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Abivax reported cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments of €402.4 million at June 30, 2026, which combined with the €767.1 million in net proceeds from its July ADS offering gives a projected cash runway into Q4 2029; H1 net loss widened to €165.9 million on R&D spend of €107.9 million. The company reaffirmed it remains on track to submit the obefazimod NDA to the FDA for ulcerative colitis by the end of 2026, announced that CMO Fabio Cataldi will depart in Q4 2026 to be succeeded by Chris Rabbat alongside new CTO Tim Kelly, and said it will present further obefazimod data at UEGW in October 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $101, Maintains Overweight Rating
news.summary: Morgan Stanley lifted its price target on Abivax's U.S.-listed ADS from $71 to $101 while keeping an Overweight rating, citing growing confidence in obefazimod's competitive profile in ulcerative colitis ahead of the planned FDA filing. The move added to an already unanimously bullish sell-side stance on the stock.

news.headline: Goldman Sachs Initiates Coverage on Abivax With Buy Rating, $155 Price Target
news.summary: Goldman Sachs analyst Rajan Sharma started coverage of Abivax with a Buy rating and a $155 price target, calling obefazimod's Phase 3 ABTECT efficacy and maintenance data "biologic-like" in an oral pill and modeling peak sales of roughly €4 billion in ulcerative colitis. The initiation extended an already unanimous Buy-side analyst consensus on the stock (11 Buys, zero Hold/Sell prior to Goldman's addition).

news.headline: The Drugmaker Abivax Has Still Not Been Acquired. What's Going On?
news.source: STAT News (Adam's Biotech Scorecard, Adam Feuerstein)
news.summary: Nine months after speculation first pegged a roughly $20 billion buyout of Abivax as imminent, STAT News noted the deal still had not materialized despite red-hot biotech M&A activity, with no clear public visibility into whether talks with Big Pharma suitors are ongoing. The piece frames Abivax's continued independence as a source of growing investor frustration even as obefazimod's commercial potential remains widely viewed as attractive to acquirers.

catalysts.label: Obefazimod NDA submission to FDA (ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Following a positive pre-NDA FDA interaction (July 30, 2026), Abivax reaffirmed at its Sept 21, 2026 H1 report that it remains on track to submit the NDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis by the end of 2026.

catalysts.label: Obefazimod data presentation at UEGW
catalysts.detail: Abivax confirmed at its Sept 21, 2026 H1 report that it will present additional obefazimod clinical data, including subgroup and mechanistic findings, at United European Gastroenterology Week (UEGW) in October 2026.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's investor-relations financial calendar lists its next scheduled quarterly results release for December 14, 2026, which should update cash runway, R&D spend and any regulatory progress on the obefazimod NDA.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b induction readout (Crohn's disease)
catalysts.detail: Topline 12-week induction data from the ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b trial of obefazimod in Crohn's disease remains guided for mid-2027, reaffirmed at the Sept 21, 2026 H1 report.

catalysts.label: Potential acquisition by Big Pharma
catalysts.detail: Recurring 2026 media reports have linked Abivax to takeover interest from large pharmaceutical companies, but as of STAT News' Sept 3, 2026 report no deal has materialized and both sides have declined to confirm talks, with management continuing to emphasize a standalone U.S. launch strategy instead.

pulse: Abivax's Sept 21, 2026 H1 report reaffirmed that the obefazimod NDA for ulcerative colitis remains on track for FDA filing by end-2026, with further data due at UEGW in October and the next quarterly update set for Dec 14; a wider-than-expected net loss triggered target trims from Wedbush ($118) and Truist ($151), though Barclays held its $148 Overweight view. The sell-side remains overwhelmingly bullish following Goldman Sachs' Buy initiation ($155 PT) and Morgan Stanley's hike to $101 earlier in September, with cash runway now extended into Q4 2029 after the July $920M offering. The Crohn's ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b readout stays guided for mid-2027, CMO Fabio Cataldi is handing off to Chris Rabbat in Q4 2026, and long-running Big Pharma takeover speculation remains unresolved per STAT News, with management still building out an independent U.S. commercial launch.
